items.title: Semiconductor stocks sink over fears of increased competition from China
items.summary: Worries over increased competition from China sent semiconductor stocks lower on Monday.

items.title: The Market Is Missing a Huge Opportunity in NVIDIA, Micron, and Broadcom
items.summary: NVIDIA, Micron, and Broadcom have powered some of the most explosive earnings in market history, yet each stock trades at a fraction of what its forward numbers could justify. Here is where the math points by 2027.

items.title: Seagate and Western Digital Dive 6%, SK Hynix and Micron Slide 5% as Memory Stocks Cool
items.summary: Memory stocks are taking a sharp hit Monday after an extraordinary run, but Wall Street analysts and a major insider are already treating the selloff as something very different from what the price action suggests.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps 600 Points On Trump Strikes Reversal; Oil Prices Plunge (Live Coverage)
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rallies 600 points Monday as Trump calls off new U.S. strikes on Iran. Oil prices plunge.

items.title: New Month, Same Jitters: AI Anxiety Creeps Into August
items.summary: Investors are kicking off a new trading month on an upbeat note. But that hasn’t stopped one of July’s most painful trends from carrying into August. Chip stocks and other companies tied to the AI trade are some of the biggest decliners today, with Micron Technology, Sandisk, Intel and Western Digital all down about 3% or more.

items.title: Micron Stock Drops as Chinese Memory Threat Intensifies
items.summary: Micron Technology  was falling early Monday.  Micron shares were down 4% at $790.50 in premarket trading.  The moves comes as China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (  CXMT  ) mulls whether to build a second memory-chip plant in Beijing, following its recent initial public offering which led to the company surging to a market valuation of close to $500 billion, according to a Reuters report.

items.title: This Week In AI Chips - Palomino's Strategic Acquisition Boosts AI Interconnect Market Expansion
items.summary: Palomino Laboratories has completed its acquisition of Vega Links, positioning itself as a key player in the next-generation AI interconnect field. This strategic move significantly expands Palomino's addressable market to over $60 billion and accelerates its capabilities in AI infrastructure. With the integration of Vega Links’ expertise in high-speed AI and memory connectivity, Palomino aims to enhance AI interconnect technologies that improve bandwidth, latency, and power efficiency...
